slides.title: What Counts as a Genuine Insight
bullets: Surfaces through direct scientific exchange with a clinician or researcher
Explains the why behind a pattern, not just the pattern itself
Points toward a specific action the organisation could take
A peer-reviewed framework was built to restore this precision

slides.title: Data Describes, Insight Explains
bullets: Information describes what is happening — a data point, a metric
Insight explains why it is happening, at a decision-ready level
Charting how often a question comes up is a metric, not an insight
Understanding why physicians keep asking it is the insight

slides.title: What Every Real Insight Contains
bullets: Grounded in something real — an observation, conversation or pattern
Interpretation — a reasoned why, not an assumption
Pattern recognition across multiple interactions, not just one
Relevance — a plausible link to a decision the organisation can make

slides.title: Insight Generation Is Not Automatic
bullets: Not a byproduct that just happens during good scientific exchange
This module builds it as a deliberate, systematic skill
Covers spotting false insights, the data-to-implication ladder, capture and writing
Also covers bias, sharing internally, and connecting insight to strategy

slides.title: The Differentiator Between Average and Strategic
bullets: Industry analysis is consistent on this point
Generating and acting on genuine insight separates strategic Medical Affairs
It is a core professional capability, not a nice-to-have

takeaway.title: A genuine insight explains a why and points to an action, not just information
bullets: Information describes what happened; insight explains why
Real insight needs grounding, interpretation and relevance together
Insight generation is a skill this module builds step by step
